# Collectron: Enclave Repair Bot Station

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 19, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Jul 13, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9fa7103f917944d59ce3587a6c29c7cd~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Enclave Repair Bot Station__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_42b874c673ce460781b2eb5271d50f8d~mv2.jpg)

Trust the Enclave to keep your C.A.M.P. in tip-top shape.

__Overview__

The Enclave Repair Bot Station restores health to damaged C.A.M.P. objects over time.

When a camp item takes damage and its health bar is reduced, the bot will automatically repair the item, gradually restoring the lost health to the bar.

However, it will not repair items that have been completely destroyed, whether by players or NPC enemies.

__Function__

Repairs damaged C.A.M.P. items at a rate of 2% per hour. Does not repair destroyed items.

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: All other Repair Bots
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 5

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: N/A

__How to Unlock__

Available via:

- Gleaming Depths – Enclave Armory Bundle *(Real-World Money)*

Storefronts:

- Microsoft Store
- Sony Store
- Steam Store

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
